purpose: A compact tag for a filter, an applied selection or an entered value, which can be toggled and, with its close control, removed. Use it where the person changes what is applied.

notFor.case: A static status, count or category.
Typing values that turn into tags inside a field.
Exactly one of a few modes or views.

Default.visual: outline: no fill, Border/control edge, Content/primary text (status variants: Status/<severity>/border and Status/<severity>/content); soft: Surface/muted fill (Status/<severity>/surface).

Hover.visual: outline: Surface/muted fill, Border/control-hover edge; soft: Surface/muted-hover (status variants: surface / border-strong, or surface-pressed).

Focused.visual: Border/focus edge with a Border/ring/default halo (status variants: Status/<severity>/border-strong with a Status/<severity>/border halo).

Selected.meaning: The filter or value is applied (aria-pressed).
Selected.visual: Surface/selected fill, Border/accent edge, Content/accent text (status variants: Status/<severity>/surface-pressed with Status/<severity>/border-strong).

Disabled.visual: outline: Border/subtle edge, Content/disabled text; soft: Action/disabled/default fill, Content/disabled text.

Dragging.meaning: Set by the app's drag-and-drop while the person drags the chip.
Dragging.visual: outline: Surface/layer-1 fill, Border/strong edge; soft: Surface/muted-hover fill, Border/strong edge; Content/primary text.

a11y.role: button with aria-pressed; the close control is a separate button named "Remove" plus the label
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches the chip and, when shown, its close control. Enter or Space toggles the chip or activates Remove.
notes: Disabled sets aria-disabled and disables both buttons.
Fill, edge, text and scale move on use-hover; a press sinks like a button (motion only, owner decision 2026-11-19).

openQuestions: Reduced motion: should the hover scale and the press sink be dropped while colour transitions stay?
Dragging: which drag-and-drop pattern sets it, and how is a drag done by keyboard?
